posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md:
this 12"diameter rainbow hologram is named "Aftershock" as when the Holocenter gave me the glass blanks the newspaper it was wrapped in had the headline "Aftershock" from post 911 issues.....

![Image](http://photos-d.ak.fbcdn.net/hphotos-ak-snc1/hs231.snc1/7833_1236728281488_1327674683_690227_3309034_n.jpg)

posts.content_md: Nice! Were the balls backlit discs of translucent glass?

posts.author: The_Stranger
posts.content_md:
Wow, I just noticed the youtube link, that really makes it clear how beautiful this hologram is, and quite artistic. I followed that youtube link and found your "spatial spirals", which, to be honest, I like even more. It is a nice step away from the "usual" statues and such. These also make for beautiful holo's, but this is just something different..

Again, wow...

posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md: Hi guys thanks for the nice comments, yes this is a "one step" hologram and the images were made from paper cut-outs and then backlit. When i recieved the glass i just had to fill it with more circles. I've since made three different sized pieces that are all at differing heights to be all viewed together .......
